decidedBy: Roger, on Captain's focused rerun. Not a counsel approval.

originalClaim.what: scripts/rcap-hosted-acceptance-preparation.test.mjs failed 3 of 10 on stale CLI-era bindings: a superseded accepted-worker identity fixture, an equivalence assertion that compared the accepted tree with itself under two names, and scope/deployment assertions written for the Vercel CLI after the deploy path moved to the REST transport.
originalClaim.whyItWasDeferred: It was established as pre-existing rather than candidate-caused, was not in the selected Mission Lock control set, and was named so the next pass would start from a list rather than a rediscovery.

failing: 5 - Mississippi Preview preparation is bounded to four synthetic identities and a two-participant scope
6 - same worker source SHA reuses the accepted immutable digest
7 - distinct evidence-only SHA reuses the digest with the accepted image revision
theDefectWasLiveAtCaptainBeforeIntegrati.soTheDispositionIsFixedRatherThanRetired: The three failures reproduced on current Captain immediately before the cherry-pick, and the same three pass immediately after. The repair is measured against a live red, not asserted.

integration.method: git cherry-pick -x onto Captain. Codex was not asked to rebase or recreate the patch.

ancestryDifferenceVerifiedIndependently.task42FilesChangedInRange: none — git diff over both patched paths across the range is empty
ancestryDifferenceVerifiedIndependently.note: The range is one commit longer than it was when the cherry-pick was authorised, because the #58 and #61 launch-safety receipts landed in between. It is the same kind of difference: receipts only, and neither #42 file moved.

byteIdentityWithTheCandidate.scripts/rcap-hosted-acceptance-preparati: blob 01b3455c263a91a41e7e32a9f501887dc0ba89f5 on both the candidate and integrated Captain

integration.noOtherSemanticMovement: git diff --name-only 211cc19ce e74c02f0d over src/, data/, supabase/, deploy/, .github/, docs/, package.json and package-lock.json is empty.
integration.notAdded: No package script, CI wiring or workflow entry was added for the standalone mutation script. That was not the original defect and adding it would alter worker inputs.

acceptance.preparationBaseline: 10/10 — every previously failing test now passes and no previously passing test regressed.
acceptance.releaseContainment: scripts/test-rcap-release-containment.mjs — PASS. Three actual acceptance shells, publication main/release, outsider and missing-SHA denial, stale-branch reproduction, scope and bypass mutations.

mutations.greenUnmutatedBaselineRequiredFirst: The suite asserts the unmutated control exits 0 before any mutation is applied, so credit is not available from an already-red file.
detail: scope hash removed from REST metadata — caught
metadata omitted from REST invocation — caught
mutations.eachMutationIsProvenToApplyExactlyOnce: The suite asserts a unique match before mutating, so a silently-missed mutation cannot count itself undetected.
mutations.isolation: Mutations are written only to copies inside a temporary fixture directory; the repository's own scripts are symlinked read-only and the Git directory is symlinked rather than copied. The Git directory was confirmed intact after the run and the working tree stayed clean.

static.targetedLint: npx eslint on both files — exit 0, no findings

workerInputEffect.patchMovement: ZERO. git diff --name-only across the ten canonical worker inputs (package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, scripts/rcap-render-worker.mjs, scripts/lib, src, deploy/rcap-render-worker/Dockerfile, deploy/rcap-render-worker/Dockerfile.dockerignore, data/record-clearing/supplemental-guides, data/record-clearing/brand/legalease-logo.png) between 211cc19ce and e74c02f0d returns nothing. Both patched files are outside the canonical set.
workerInputEffect.soNoRepublication: #42 authorises no worker build, publication or digest repin.

separateAndPreserved.what: Captain as a whole still differs from the accepted worker source 117b469c4 across the canonical set.
separateAndPreserved.statement: This drift predates #42 and is not caused by it. It is a legitimate release prerequisite belonging to #49 and to final worker publication. It is not suppressed, repinned, or regenerated against a moving Captain here.

notPartOfThisDisposition.why: Recorded as measurement, not as a reopening. The 2026-09-21 register listed five controls in the CLI-era cohort. This patch repairs the preparation file's three failures; the other three controls were measured at integrated Captain and remain red. They are named here so their redness is not later mistaken for an #42 regression, and no work on them is started or implied.
notPartOfThisDisposition.theseAreNotGates: The 2026-09-21 record establishes that no workflow runs any of them, so none gates hosted_full.
notPartOfThisDisposition.whoDecides: Whether they are repaired, retired or left recorded is Roger's call, not Captain's, and it is outside the bounded #42 scope he defined.

futureTrigger: Reopen only if these preparation bindings regress — that is, if scripts/rcap-hosted-acceptance-preparation.test.mjs stops passing 10/10, or the mutation suite stops catching 6/6 from a green baseline. Redness in any other CLI-era control is not an #42 regression.
denominatorEffect: #42 leaves the active substantive Mission Lock denominator.
